first_error.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
first_error.critic_note: (specific flag) The reviews at [41] and [47] said exact-phrase matching drops matters attributed in other wording and suggested searching variants; the agent's next stage named that goal but only read the eleven candidates.
first_error.why: The completed scan keyed attribution on the exact practice-group name, which one investigation matter with an issued hold does not use (the scan shows it with zero name hits and twelve hold hits), and no variant search followed.

other_errors.critic_note: (specific flag) The screening review at [84] said the matter was counted though its hold files failed to open and only an account-freeze letter was read; the agent listed its files and kept it.
other_errors.why: The answer counts a sentencing matter as having an issued hold on a third-party preservation email and an account-freeze letter (evidence seen at [63]-[89]).

divergence: Mixed (T1 passes; T0 and T2 fail). The runs split at how the candidate pool was built from the store-wide scans. T1 ran an exact-name scan, then, after a stage with no calls drew a 'no search ran' review, a broader scan for the short name and acronym that added the matter attributed in other wording; it screened every candidate's attribution documents. T2 kept the exact-name pool although two reviews named the variant-wording gap (one suggested an agent-defined stage, which it opened but used only for reading), and it also counted a matter without a hold document after a specific flag. T0 used loose patterns that found the variant matter, but its agent-defined attribution stage worked from 14 hand-typed candidates that omitted one scan-surfaced matter; the review there warned only generically. Label notes played no role.
